likeness_references.people_in_frame: Four men stand in a row before the wood-paneled wall of the Presidency of the Senate, under a gilded coat of arms, in front of a carved dark sofa, with framed paintings and chairs at the sides and a dark table edge across the bottom. Lupi is third from the left: the only bearded man, frontal, smiling with upper teeth showing, bright royal-blue windowpane-check jacket, darker slate-navy trousers, white shirt, burgundy-red tie with white diagonal stripes, hands clasped in front at waist height, black shoes mostly covered by the trouser hems. The other three are Senate President Renan Calheiros, senator Acir Gurgacz and deputy André Figueiredo (named in the caption); the prompt excludes them and the setting. No lapel pin is visible on Lupi.
likeness_references.identity_evidence: The Commons description names 'o presidente do PDT, Carlos Lupi'; Commons structured data depicts Carlos Lupi (Q9697177) (the file is returned by haswbstatement:P180=Q9697177); Commons category Carlos Lupi; embedded IPTC keyword 'Carlos Lupi'. He is the only bearded man of the four, and his face matches the batch's 2009 and 2023 references and the Agência Senado frames of 28 April 2015 that name him alone.

likeness_references.limitation: A four-person group photograph, though Lupi is frontal, full length and unobstructed. Early in its window (2015) rather than near its middle (mid-2017): no verified dated 2016-2019 photograph was found, and an uploader-dated photograph of 1 May 2018 (File:Lupi.png, unverified) shows him grayer than here.

comparison_photographs_not_references.disposition: Not adopted as a likeness reference. The licence string qualifies and the subject is the exact person, but the date and the authorship rest only on the uploader's own statement: no capture metadata, a square 801x801 PNG, an IPTC transmission token, and an upload almost four months after the stated date. A press or party photograph re-posted as own work cannot be excluded on this evidence. Used only as era evidence: both new prompts cite it as an uploader-dated comparison. Whether to verify it and split window 2 of 3 again is put to Codex.

search.conclusion: On Commons, the qualifying dated photographs of Lupi closest to 2015-2019 are the Agência Senado files of April, May and August 2015. No verified dated photograph from 2016 to 2022 was found; one uploader-dated photograph of 2018 (File:Lupi.png, CC BY-SA 4.0, own-work claim and date unverified) exists and was inspected as a comparison. This is the result of this search and licence filter, not proof that none exists (for example on the Senado Federal or Câmara dos Deputados Flickr streams without a Commons copy).
